content: hstack — HyperStack CLI CLI tool for managing HyperStack GPU cloud instances. Hibernate and restore VMs, query GPU stock, SSH into instances, and create port tunnels. Installation npm (global) From source Usage Environment Variables Variable Required Description -------------------- -------- --------------------------------------------- HYPERSTACK_API_KEY Yes API key for HyperStack REST API HYPERSTACK_SSH_KEY No Path to SSH private key (used with -i flag) Documentation - AGENTS.md — Agent context and architecture overview - DEVELOPMENT.md — Developer notes, API reference, contributing guide Legal Disclaimer This software is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind, express or implied. The authors and contributors are not responsible for any data loss, service disruption, or financial damage resulting from the use of this tool. Use at your own risk. Always verify API responses and command effects before executing destructive operations (e.g., hibernate, delete). License MIT License • Free Software © 2026 Lleu Labs Inc. / Robert Fairley
